name: B10-0163/2026 (S&D) – The arbitrary detention of President Mohamed Bazoum by the junta in Niger
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary detention of President Mohamed Bazoum by the junta in Niger
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Niger's elected president, Mohamed Bazoum, who was arrested in a military coup in July 2023 and is still held with his wife. The Parliament asks Niger's authorities to free him, let him see a lawyer and a doctor, and bring back democratic rule. It also asks the European Union to keep helping people in Niger with aid and to push diplomatically for his release. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks Niger to release Bazoum and restore democracy.
- **Who it affects:** Bazoum, his family, political parties and media in Niger, and people needing aid.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to EU bodies and Niger's authorities, who are asked to act.
